sources.title: LeViT-256: The Fast Lane for Vision Transformers on Modelers.cn
sources.snippet: LeViT-256: The Fast Lane for Vision Transformers on Modelers.cn Meta's latest contribution to the computer vision landscape, LeViT-256, has landed on Modelers.cn, bringing a highly efficient hybrid backbone to the Huawei Ascend ecosystem. If you've ever felt that pure Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a bit too heavy on the compute, LeViT is designed to be the speedster of the bunch.
